name: What are the common pros and cons of owning a penthouse?

mainEntity.name: What are the common pros and cons of owning a penthouse?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pros of owning a penthouse include superior views, increased privacy, larger living spaces, and often exclusive amenities. Cons can include higher purchase prices, increased ongoing maintenance costs, and potential for longer waits for elevators. The added height can also mean more exposure to wind and weather, which is a practical tradeoff in coastal areas like Fort Lauderdale Beach or Sunny Isles Beach, requiring robust insurance and building maintenance. Weighing these aspects helps determine if a penthouse aligns with your lifestyle and budget.
acceptedAnswer.description: Pros are views, privacy, and space; cons include higher costs and potential elevator waits. Consider increased weather exposure in coastal areas.
